title: Knowledge base
text:
Title: Knowledge base

In computer science, a knowledge base (KB) is a set of sentences, each sentence given in a knowledge representation language, with interfaces 
to tell new sentences and to ask questions about what is known, where either of these interfaces might use inference. It is a technology used to store 
complex structured data used by a computer system. The initial use of the term was in connection with expert systems, which were the first knowledge-based systems.
